name: Coherent

eyebrow.en: Coherent Corp. · Common stock · Saxonburg, Pennsylvania
eyebrow.zh: Coherent · 普通股 · 宾州萨克森堡

title.en: AI optics growth, paid for up front.
title.zh: AI 光学高增长，先投入后回报。

lede.en: Coherent makes optical transceivers, indium phosphide lasers and industrial lasers. Datacenter & Communications is now 82% of revenue and grew 79% last quarter, and management expects FY27 growth above 60% and a $3B quarter by June 2027. Paying for that growth took $776M of capex in one quarter, so free cash flow is deeply negative.
lede.zh: Coherent 生产光模块、磷化铟激光器和工业激光器。数据中心与通信业务已占营收 82%，上季增长 79%；管理层预计 FY27 增长逾 60%，并在 2027 年 6 月前实现单季 30 亿美元营收。为支撑增长，单季资本开支达 7.76 亿美元，自由现金流深度为负。

s.zh: FY27 一致预期每股 $8.71（非GAAP）· GAAP 历史每股 $4.82，约 40 倍

s.en: Q2 FY27 · date not yet announced
s.zh: FY27 第二季 · 日期未公布

sub_price.en: Daily closes with the 50-day average. The stock roughly tripled to a $427 close in June, then lost more than half as AI hardware sold off.
sub_price.zh: 每日收盘价与50日均线。股价在6月涨至约三倍、收于 $427，之后随 AI 硬件股下跌回落逾一半。

sub_rev.en: Revenue in US$ millions, with GAAP gross margin on the right axis. Coherent's fiscal year ends June 30; FY22 is II-VI before it bought Coherent in July 2022 and took its name. The last bar is Q2 FY27 guidance at the midpoint.
sub_rev.zh: 营收单位为百万美元，右轴为 GAAP 毛利率。Coherent 财年截至6月30日；FY22 为 II-VI 在 2022年7月收购 Coherent 并更名之前的数据。最后一根柱为 FY27 第二季指引中值。

s.en: pro forma growth · $3B quarter by Jun 2027
s.zh: 备考增长 · 2027年6月前单季 30 亿

p.en: Datacenter & Communications grew 79% YoY to $1.95B in Q1, and the Q2 guide of $2.55–2.75B was about 4% above consensus. Management sees a $3B quarter by June 2027 and a $4B quarter in FY28.
p.zh: FY27 第一季数据中心与通信收入同比增 79% 至 19.5 亿美元，第二季指引 25.5–27.5 亿美元，高于市场预期约 4%。管理层预计 2027 年 6 月前实现单季 30 亿美元，FY28 实现单季 40 亿美元。

p.en: Non-GAAP gross margin rose to 40.6% on pricing and cost cuts, and the CFO raised the long-term goal: a quarter above 45% before the end of 2028.
p.zh: 受定价优化与成本改善带动，非GAAP毛利率升至 40.6%；CFO 上调长期目标：2028 年底前实现单季毛利率逾 45%。

p.en: 6-inch InP lines run in Texas and Sweden, with Zurich due in the first half of 2027. A 6-inch wafer gives four times the output of a 3-inch one at half the cost.
p.zh: 德州与瑞典的 6 英寸磷化铟产线已投产，苏黎世工厂预计 2027 年上半年加入。6 英寸晶圆产出是 3 英寸的四倍、成本减半。

p.en: Q1 capex jumped to $776M while operating cash flow was −$93M, so free cash flow was about −$868M. Cash fell to $1.55B against $4.0B of debt.
p.zh: 第一季资本开支升至 7.76 亿美元，经营现金流为 −9300 万，自由现金流约 −8.68 亿。现金降至 15.5 亿美元，债务 40 亿。

p.en: Industrial revenue fell 15% YoY to $419M as Coherent leans into AI.
p.zh: 随公司转向 AI，工业收入同比降 15% 至 4.19 亿美元。

p.en: InP capacity is the bottleneck; any slip in yields or the ramp caps revenue. The stock is more than half below its June high as AI hardware sold off, so position sizing matters.
p.zh: 磷化铟产能是瓶颈，良率或爬坡受阻将限制营收。随 AI 硬件股下跌，股价较 6 月高点回落逾一半，仓位控制很重要。

p.en: Guide: $2.55–2.75B revenue, 40–42% non-GAAP gross margin, EPS $2.28–2.48.

h.zh: 苏黎世 6 英寸磷化铟产线

p.en: Third 6-inch indium phosphide site is planned to start production.
p.zh: 第三个 6 英寸磷化铟工厂计划投产。

p.en: Management expects its first quarter above $3B of revenue by the end of FY27.
p.zh: 管理层预计在 FY27 结束前实现首个营收逾 30 亿美元的季度。

sources: Q1 FY27 profit, segments and outlook (Investing.com)
Price and market cap: Yahoo Finance daily closes, as of Nov 4, 2026

foot.en: Fundamentals as of Nov 4, 2026 (Q1 FY27 results). For information only, not investment advice. Not affiliated with Coherent Corp..
foot.zh: 基本面数据截至 2026年11月4日（FY27 第一季业绩）。仅供参考，不构成投资建议。与 Coherent Corp. 无关联。

sub.en: Free cash flow is operating cash flow minus capital spending, in US$ millions, for the 20 quarters from Q2 FY22 to Q1 FY27. Coherent's fiscal year ends June 30. Shaded bars and italic rows are estimates.
sub.zh: 自由现金流 = 经营现金流 − 资本开支，单位百万美元，涵盖 FY22 第二季至 FY27 第一季共 20 个季度。Coherent 财年截至6月30日。浅色柱与斜体行为估算。

read.en: Coherent used to produce modest free cash flow: most quarters from 2023 to 2025 brought in $24–137M. That reversed in FY26, at about −$1B for the year, and got worse in Q1 FY27: operating cash flow was −$93M as inventory and receivables grew with 50% revenue growth, and capex jumped to $776M, so free cash flow was about −$868M in a single quarter.
read.zh: Coherent 过去自由现金流不大：2023 至 2025 年多数季度为 2400 万至 1.37 亿美元。FY26 情况逆转，全年约 −10 亿美元；FY27 第一季进一步恶化：随营收增长 50%，库存与应收款增加，经营现金流为 −9300 万美元，资本开支升至 7.76 亿，单季自由现金流约 −8.68 亿。

read.en: Capex stays high while Coherent adds 6-inch indium phosphide capacity, including Zurich in the first half of 2027. I assume $550–700M of capex a quarter and operating cash flow recovering toward $450M as profits outrun working capital, which still leaves about −$1.2B over four quarters. That is close to the $1.55B of cash, so more borrowing or other funding is likely if capex does not ease.
read.zh: 在增加 6 英寸磷化铟产能（含 2027 年上半年投产的苏黎世工厂）期间，资本开支仍将维持高位。我假设每季资本开支 5.5–7 亿美元，经营现金流随利润增速超过营运资金而回升至约 4.5 亿，四季合计仍约 −12 亿。这接近 15.5 亿美元的现金，若资本开支不放缓，可能需要新增借款或其他融资。

p.en: 6-inch lines in Texas and Sweden, with Zurich due in the first half of 2027. Capex was $776M in Q1 FY27, up from $556M in Q4.
p.zh: 德州与瑞典的 6 英寸产线，苏黎世工厂预计 2027 年上半年投产。FY27 第一季资本开支 7.76 亿美元，上季为 5.56 亿。

p.en: Inventory and receivables rise with datacenter growth, which is why operating cash flow was negative despite $382M of GAAP net income.
p.zh: 库存与应收款随数据中心增长而上升，因此尽管 GAAP 净利润达 3.82 亿美元，经营现金流仍为负。

p.en: About $4.0B of debt, almost all long-term, after paying down about $0.5B in FY26.
p.zh: FY26 偿还约 5 亿美元后，债务约 40 亿美元，几乎全为长期债务。

p.en: Q2 FY27 is guided to $2.55–2.75B of revenue, and FY27 pro forma growth above 60%.
p.zh: FY27 第二季营收指引 25.5–27.5 亿美元，FY27 备考增长逾 60%。

p.en: Non-GAAP gross margin of 40.6% is guided to 40–42% in Q2, with a goal above 45% by the end of 2028 as 6-inch InP ramps.
p.zh: 非GAAP毛利率 40.6%，第二季指引 40–42%；随 6 英寸磷化铟放量，目标在 2028 年底前超过 45%。

bridgeNote.en: Excludes new borrowing, debt repayment, divestitures and buybacks. Restricted cash is not counted.
bridgeNote.zh: 未计入新增借款、偿债、资产出售与回购，不含受限现金。

extraNote.en: FY2022 figures are II-VI before it acquired Coherent in July 2022.
extraNote.zh: FY2022 数据为 II-VI 在 2022年7月收购 Coherent 之前的数据。
